scope: Frozen first comparison; adapted donor strategy is not the untouched original generator

launch_protocol.scope: Adopted donor four-author strategy versus native single author, same bounded transport and independent frozen input oracle; original donor planner failure recorded separately

original_donor_planner_probe.scope: Untouched donor planner only; no generated source or browser execution

limitations: The original donor was probed only at its planner, not measured as ten completed games
Four-author budget-reservation failures precede source candidates and do not establish gameplay quality
First submitted candidate passing may follow several author responses and local corrections
Small sample and fixed public controls do not establish arbitrary-genre reliability
Contest WebView host is unknown; evidence uses isolated Chromium desktop and mobile profiles
Independent agent review is separate from real human evaluation
